tooltip.geore_nouveau.aluminum_charm: Obtained by performing the Ritual of Awakening near Budding Aluminium Geore
tooltip.geore_nouveau.aluminum_dowsing_r: Grants Magic Find and Scrying on use, causing magical creatures to glow and Aluminium Geore to be revealed through blocks. Can be used on Imbuement Chamber and Enchanting Apparatus to highlight linked pedestals.
